tailoring.headline: Proxy Product Owner E-Commerce | SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years of experience building enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines deep backend expertise in Java, Spring Boot and OCC REST APIs with strong business analysis skills: requirements engineering, user stories, stakeholder management, process mapping and agile delivery. SAP Certified Developer and Business User, experienced in aligning business goals with technical execution across international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Proxy Product Owner (all genders) E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: valantic's reputation for delivering top-tier digital solutions makes this Proxy Product Owner role an exciting next step for my career. With over 5 years of hands-on experience developing enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.

bullets.label: Requirements & User Stories
bullets.text: Extensively gathered business requirements, authored user stories and functional specifications, and translated them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with international business stakeholders, product owners and technical teams to align e-commerce roadmaps and resolve integration bottlenecks.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Combined deep backend proficiency in Java, Spring and OCC REST APIs with process mapping, gap analysis and user acceptance testing (UAT).

bullets.label: Agile E-Commerce Solutions
bullets.text: Delivered complex enterprise projects within agile Scrum frameworks, ensuring seamless PIM, ERP and MDM data integration across global channels.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Proxy Product Owner (all genders) E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: valantic steht für erstklassige digitale Lösungen und exzellente E-Commerce-Projekte – genau das Umfeld, in dem ich als Proxy Product Owner Verantwortung übernehmen möchte. Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Steuerung großer E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verbinde ich tiefes technisches Know-how mit zielgerichteter Business-Analyse.

bullets.label: Anforderungsanalyse & User Stories
bullets.text: Ich habe Geschäftsanforderungen detailliert analysiert, User Stories sowie funktionale Spezifikationen erstellt und diese erfolgreich in SAP Commerce Lösungen übersetzt.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-Management
bullets.text: Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Business-Stakeholdern, Product Ownern und technischen Teams zur Abstimmung von Anforderungen und Prozessen gehörte zu meinem täglichen Fokus.

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Stärke
bullets.text: Durch meine technische Expertise in Java, Spring und OCC APIs begleite ich den gesamten Prozess von der Anforderungserhebung über das Mapping bis zur User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

bullets.label: Agile Umsetzung
bullets.text: Ich bin mit agilen Arbeitsweisen bestens vertraut und steure die Umsetzung komplexer PIM- und ERP-Integrationsprojekte zielgerichtet im Scrum-Team.

cover_de.logistics: Standort Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, Eintritt ab 16.12.2026, Einladung zum Gespräch

tailoring.why_company: valantic's holistic approach to digital transformation and e-commerce excellence resonates strongly with my background. My techno-functional expertise bridges business needs and technical delivery, enabling me to drive value for valantic's clients from day one.
tailoring.motivation_short: Combining 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise with strong requirements engineering and stakeholder management to drive successful e-commerce projects at valantic.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an experienced SAP Commerce developer and techno-functional consultant with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am very interested in the Proxy Product Owner role at valantic and would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Proxy Product Owner (all genders) E-Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Proxy Product Owner role at valantic. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise in bridging business requirements with technical execution in SAP Commerce environments.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available starting December 16, 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
